```{r}
#| context: setup

# Importar dades

# source(here::here("Scripts/Eina/Dataset prova.R"))

library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(tidylog)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(purrr)
library(haven)
library(readxl)
library(readxl)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(ggpubr)
library(stringdist)
library(sjmisc)
library(jtools)
library(modelsummary)
library(broom)
library(gt)
library(patchwork)
library(sf)
library(collapse)
library(networkD3)
library(labelled)
library(openxlsx)
library(arrow)
library(tsibble) # ARIMA
library(fable) # ARIMA
library(shiny)
library(ggiraph)

# Nombre d'especialitats
n_esp <- 5

# OFERTA: Profes ----

dades_profes <- data.frame(
  curs = rep(2018:2032, times = n_esp),
  # PROFES (escenari_interval)
  baix_min = rnorm(15*n_esp,1000, 10)) %>% 
  mutate(
    baix_mig = baix_min + 10,
    baix_max = baix_min + 20,
    mig_min = baix_min + 30,
    mig_mig = baix_min + 40,
    mig_max = baix_min + 50,
    alt_min = baix_min + 60,
    alt_mig = baix_min + 70,
    alt_max = baix_min + 80,
    ) %>% 
  # ESPECIALITAT
  group_by(curs) %>% 
  mutate(especialitat = row_number()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  relocate(especialitat, .after = curs) %>% 
  # Reformar
  pivot_longer(
    3:last_col(),
    names_to = "name",
    values_to = "value") %>%
  # Variables de característiques
  mutate(escenari = case_when(
    str_detect(name, "baix") == T ~ "Baix",
    str_detect(name, "^mig") == T ~ "Mig",
    str_detect(name, "alt") == T ~ "Alt")) %>% 
  mutate(interval = case_when(
    str_detect(name, "min$") == T ~ "Min",
    str_detect(name, "mig$") == T ~ "Mig",
    str_detect(name, "max$") == T ~ "Max")) %>%   
  select(-name) %>% 
  rename(profes = value) %>% 
  # generar dos escenaris mes
  uncount(2, .id = "expanded") %>% 
  mutate(ratio = case_when(
    expanded == 1 ~ "Flexible",
    expanded == 2 ~ "Fix")) %>% 
  select(-expanded) %>% 
  # reformatejar per interval
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "interval",
    values_from = "profes") %>% 
  mutate(across(c(Min:Max), ~ case_when(
    ratio == "Flexible" ~ . + 10,
    T ~ .)))




dades_profes_tot <- dades_profes %>% 
  group_by(curs, escenari, ratio) %>% 
  summarise(
    Min = sum(Min, na.rm = T),
    Mig = sum(Mig, na.rm = T),
    Max = sum(Max, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ungroup

paleta_ivalua <- c("#002C4B", "#40617a", "#4A5C83", "#6782a1",
                   "#74b2c0", "#81c6d0","#bcdfe4", "#e5e4e4",
                   "#fac5c5", "#d72132", "#C0001B")

library(extrafont)
loadfonts(quiet = TRUE)

theme_ivalua <- function(base_size = 11,
                         base_family = "Roboto",
                         base_line_size = base_size / 22,
                         base_rect_size = base_size / 22,
                         axis_text_x = TRUE,
                         axis_text_y = FALSE,
                         axis_titles = FALSE) {
  t <- ggplot2::theme_classic(
    base_size = base_size,
    base_family = base_family,
    base_line_size = base_line_size,
    base_rect_size = base_rect_size
  ) + # need to eventually change to replace()
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = base_family,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0
      ),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = base_family,
        face = "plain"
      ),
      plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = base_family,
        size = base_size + 1,
        hjust = 0,
        vjust = 1.2,
        face = "plain"
      ),
      axis.line.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.line.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = base_size,
        angle = 0
      ),
      strip.text.y.left = ggplot2::element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = base_size,
        angle = 0
      ),
      strip.text.y.right = ggplot2::element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = base_size,
        angle = 0
      ),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = base_family,
        face = "plain",
        size = base_size
      ),
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = base_family,
        face = "plain",
        size = base_size
      ),
      axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = base_family,
        face = "plain"
      ),
      axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = base_family,
        face = "plain"
      )
    )
  if(!axis_titles){
    t <- t +
      theme(axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
            axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_blank())
  }
  if(!axis_text_y){
    t <- t +
      theme(axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank())
  }
  if(!axis_text_x){
    t <- t +
      theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank())
  }
  return(t)
}





```

##  {.sidebar}

```{r}

#| context: server


sliderInput("curs_range", "Selecciona els cursos:",
            min = min(dades_profes$curs),
            max = max(dades_profes$curs),
            value = c(min(dades_profes$curs), max(dades_profes$curs)),
            step = 1,
            sep = "")

checkboxGroupInput(
  "escenari_filter", 
  "Selecciona l'escenari:",
  choices = levels(as.factor(dades_profes$escenari)),
  selected = levels(as.factor(dades_profes$escenari))[1]
)

selectInput(
  "ratio_filter", 
  "Selecciona la ràtio:",
  choices = levels(as.factor(dades_profes$ratio)),
  selected = levels(as.factor(dades_profes$ratio))[1]
)

checkboxGroupInput(
  "especialitat_filter", 
  "Selecciona l'especialitat:",
  choices = levels(as.factor(dades_profes$especialitat)),
  selected = levels(as.factor(dades_profes$especilaitat))[1]
)

```

## Gràfic de previsió {width = 50%}

```{r}
plotOutput("grafic_previsio")
```

```{r}
#| context: server

output$grafic_previsio <- renderPlot({
  
  req(input$curs_range)
  
  # Filtrar les dades segons els inputs seleccionats
  dades_filtrades <- dades_profes_tot %>%
    filter(escenari %in% input$escenari_filter,
           ratio == input$ratio_filter,
           curs >= input$curs_range[1],
           curs <= input$curs_range[2])
  
  # Crear el gràfic amb ggplot
  ggplot(dades_filtrades, aes(x = curs)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Min, ymax = Max,
                    fill = escenari),
                alpha = .3) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Mig,
                  color = escenari),
              linewidth = 1.2) +
    labs(
      title = "Professorat total",
      x = "",
      y = "",
      fill = "Escenari",
      color = "Escenari",
      caption = "Font: Anàlisi de previsió de professorat"
    ) +
    theme_ivalua(axis_text_y = T) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0,3000,1))+
     scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Alt" = "#d72132",
    "Baix" = "#74b2c0",
    "Mig" = "#002C4B")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Alt" = "#d72132",
    "Baix" = "#74b2c0",
    "Mig" = "#002C4B"
  )) 
    
})
```

output$grafic_especialitat <- renderPlot({

           ratio == input$ratio_filter,

  # Crear el gràfic amb ggplot
  ggplot(dades_filtrades, aes(x = curs)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Min, ymax = Max,
                    fill = escenari),
                alpha = .3) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Mig,
                  color = escenari),
              linewidth = 1.2) +
    labs(
      title = "Professorat per especialitat",
      x = "",
      y = "",
      caption = "Font: Anàlisi de previsió de professorat"
    ) +
    theme_ivalua(axis_text_y = T) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    ) +

      breaks = seq(0,3000,1))+
    # scale_y_continuous(
    #   limits = c(4500,5500)) +
     scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Alt" = "#d72132",
    "Baix" = "#74b2c0",
    "Mig" = "#002C4B")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Alt" = "#d72132",
    "Baix" = "#74b2c0",
    "Mig" = "#002C4B"

})
